ZMB.note: The document states nothing on rules or an authority on AI harms.

facts.fact: Zambia Monitor quotes the Zambia Revenue Authority's Commissioner-General saying that on 16 July 2026 the ZRA already has an Artificial Intelligence Unit and has introduced an AI-powered chatbot, an HS Code search engine and a taxpayer nudging system.

ZMB.note: The document does not say the nudging system or search engine uses AI, and gives no score, forecast or decision from the chatbot.
No AI model, dataset or computing built or hosted in the country is stated; the Secure Data Lab is a revenue data facility.
